root_idea.summary: The root centers on openness, lightness, and ease, with a second lexical branch referring to the left-hand side or limb.
root_idea.development: From the idea of something opening or becoming light and manageable develop meanings of ease, facilitation, readiness, gentleness, sufficiency, and abundance; the separate bodily branch yields left-sidedness and related directional expressions.

senses.definition: To make easy, facilitate, or smooth something; also to prepare or adapt someone for a course or state.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction يَسَّرَهُ لِـ, the construction may describe disposition toward ease or toward difficulty, according to the following course or state.

senses.definition: To become easy, facilitated, or readily available; to be easy to obtain or provide.
senses.usage_conditions: The expression مَا تَيَسَّرَ denotes whatever is readily available or manageable in the circumstances.

senses.definition: To be obtainable or available with ease.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence concerning sacrificial offerings, the object is whatever offering can be obtained or provided with ease.

senses.definition: A state or period of financial ease and sufficient means.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic legal context, it is the debtor’s eventual ability to repay, contrasted with hardship or inability.

senses.definition: A game of chance or gambling, especially the traditional game played with arrows for shares of a slaughtered camel; by extension, play involving stakes or hazard.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic term denotes gambling and games of chance; the traditional arrow game supplies the principal Classical description.

senses.definition: Made easy; easy to receive or manage, including an easy or considerate reply.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression قَوْلًا مَيْسُورًا, it describes a gracious response that does not impose difficulty on its recipient.
This adjective describes an action, matter, consequence, or condition as readily manageable or easily accomplished.

senses.definition: Small in amount or brief in extent or duration.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense explains Quranic uses where يَسِيرٌ or يَسِيرًا denotes only a little or a short while rather than ease.

senses.definition: Ease, facility, or relief from difficulty.
senses.usage_conditions: It is the substantive counterpart of difficulty or hardship and may describe ease granted in circumstances or action.

senses.definition: Ease; an easy or easier course, condition, or way.
senses.usage_conditions: In لِلْيُسْرَىٰ, it denotes the easy or easier state toward which a person may be facilitated or directed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be gentle, tractable, submissive, manageable, or easy in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said especially of a man or horse, and also of speech, things, or affairs when they are easy or gentle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be little in quantity; to be paltry or of slight worth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Classical verb use distinct from the adjective يَسِيرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come from or proceed toward someone’s left-hand side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction يَسَرَنِي describes coming on from the direction of the speaker’s left.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide something into portions or shares.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of slaughtering a she-camel and distributing its limbs or meat among participants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To play the game of chance called مَيْسِر, particularly with gaming arrows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the verbal use associated with the traditional arrow game.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare, make ready, or dispose a person or thing for a task or purpose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader Classical construction includes preparing a horse for riding and making a course ready; the Quranic disposition toward ease or difficulty is listed under the Quranic Form II sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause animals to give birth easily, with none of them perishing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a man’s camels, sheep, or goats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For livestock to abound in milk or offspring and to be ready to give birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to sheep, goats, and camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat someone gently, accommodate them, or deal easily with them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal object is commonly a person, partner, or group with whom one acts leniently.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or accompany someone on the left-hand side or direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A directional use contrasted with taking the right-hand side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a woman or female animal to give birth easily.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical expression for an easy birth, including a prayer for a pregnant woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become financially competent, sufficient, rich, or prosperous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb describes acquiring means or abundance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place camels on the left side, in contrast with placing them on the right.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the paired expression for putting animals aside in both directions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become prepared or ready for someone, or to prepare oneself for something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a readiness construction distinct from merely becoming easy or available.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a country or region to become abundant in herbage, goods, or comforts of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Classical use applied to a land’s prosperity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat one another gently and deal leniently with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal form can describe being moderate or non-exorbitant with one another, including regarding dowry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An easy birth or an act of bringing forth without difficulty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A phrase such as وِلَادَةٌ يَسْرٌ applies the quality of ease to childbirth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Light, active, and obedient legs of a beast of carriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an animal’s legs, especially when they move easily and willingly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manner of twisting a rope toward the left or downward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term contrasted with twisting from the opposite direction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A straight-forward thrust or piercing opposite the face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description contrasted with a thrust from the right or left side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ease of circumstances, competence, sufficiency, wealth, or abundance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Classical extension describes being in comfortable or prosperous circumstances; the Quranic financial-deferment form is listed under مَيْسَرَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made easy, facilitated, or prepared.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial or adjectival use that can describe something ready or prepared, including the prepared game of chance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ambidextrous; able to work or act equally with both hands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أَعْسَرُ يَسَرٌ and its feminine counterpart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The left hand, limb, side, direction, or relative location.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes sitting or turning toward the left and the left wing or side of a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Petty, contemptible, or of little weight or worth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This evaluative Classical use develops from smallness but is distinct from the Quranic neutral description of a small amount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who takes or comes from the left-hand side or direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal or agentive designation for leftward orientation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who slaughters or supervises the division of a camel into portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is associated with the division carried out for the game of chance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A participant in the game of chance, a gaming-arrow player, or a person entrusted with handling its arrows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also denote a party assembled for the game or one who contests another in a game of hazard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easier, easiest, or more facile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The corresponding feminine form is يُسْرَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Financially competent, sufficient, rich, wealthy, or opulent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person possessing adequate means; its plural is used for prosperous people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prepared, disposed, made ready, or made easy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe a person prepared for what he was created for, or a thing made ready for use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prepared pastry or dish known by a regional technical name.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A post-Classical culinary usage, explained as something easily taken or eaten.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose sheep or goats are numerous and provide abundant milk or offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A livestock-related personal description, contrasted with one whose animals are kept apart or unproductive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: She-camels that give birth easily.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural livestock designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place called Yusr.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical or toponymic use distinct from the abstract noun meaning ease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lines or markings of the palm when they are not joined together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use of the root’s separate bodily branch.
